copy.youtube:
A lake so deep you could stack five Eiffel Towers in it, and it holds a frightening share of the planet's fresh water.
I put three countries on screen. One of them has it. Three seconds, then the map zooms into the crack in the Earth where it sits, and you'll see why hundreds of rivers flow in and only one flows out.
What was your first instinct?
